kpis.description_en: Recurring in-game revenue (Ultimate Team FIFA/Madden, Apex Legends, packs). ~73% of total EA revenue. Post-launch monetization pillar.

kpis.description_en: Bookings = revenue + change in deferred revenue. Real cash KPI tracked by management (vs GAAP revenue). Includes Ultimate Team packs collected.

kpis.description_fr: Bookings franchise FC (ex-FIFA). #1 mondial sports games. Ultimate Team mode = majeure partie. Post-rupture FIFA license réussie.
kpis.description_en: FC franchise bookings (ex-FIFA). #1 sports games worldwide. Ultimate Team mode = majority. Successful post-FIFA license breakup.

kpis.description_fr: Joueurs lifetime Apex Legends (battle royale free-to-play). Déclin engagement post-pic 2022 mais reste top 5 BR mondial.
kpis.description_en: Apex Legends lifetime players (free-to-play battle royale). Engagement decline post-2022 peak but remains top 5 BR worldwide.

kpis_story.description_en: New Battlefield (Glacier project) launches H2 2025. FY26 net bookings catalyst, franchise reset post-2042 flop.

kpis_story.description_en: Skate. launches F2P 2025 after early access. Live service model test on nostalgia franchise.

_notes: EA = #2 gaming publisher (vs Activision/MSFT, TTWO). Modèle live service + franchise sport flagship.
